text.en:
Anu drew an angle of 60 degrees with a protractor, then completed a triangle.
"Can we draw it exactly?" asked Ravi.

To construct an angle with a protractor, draw a base line, place the centre of the protractor on the point, mark the angle and join. To make a triangle, we need enough information: three sides, two sides and the angle between them, or two angles and a side.
Use a compass to copy lengths. A 60 degree angle can also be made with a compass alone.
Always check the drawing by measuring.

problem.en: List what we need to draw a triangle by SAS.

prompt.en: A friend says any three angles draw one exact triangle. How will you reply?

requiredIdeas.en: Three angles give a shape but not its size.

points.en: SSS, SAS, ASA give a triangle.
